answers.text: the maximum amount of output that can be produced with a given set of inputs
the minimum cost of producing a given level of output
the amount of output produced per unit of input
the change in total output from the last unit of input

feedback: Correct! A production function defines the maximum amount of output that can be produced with a given set of inputs. It summarizes the technology available for converting inputs such as capital and labor into output.

questions.text: The marginal product can be characterized as ______.

answers.text: the maximum level of output that can be produced with a given amount of inputs
the measure of output produced per unit of input
the change in total output attributable to the last unit of input
the change in total output attributable to the first unit of input

feedback: Correct! The marginal product can be characterized as the change in total output attributable to the last unit of input.

questions.text: The range of input usage over which marginal product is positive but declining is known as ______.

answers.text: increasing marginal returns
decreasing marginal returns
negative marginal returns
constant marginal returns

feedback: Correct! Over the range of decreasing (also called diminishing) marginal returns, each additional unit of input still adds to output, but less than the unit before it. Marginal returns become negative once marginal product falls below zero.

questions.text: A manager maximizes profits with respect to labor when ______.

answers.text: the marginal product of labor is equal to the wage
the value marginal product of labor is equal to the wage
the marginal product of labor is greater than the wage
the value marginal product of labor is greater than the wage

feedback: Correct! A manager should hire labor up to the point where the value marginal product of labor (the value of the output produced by the last worker) equals the wage.

questions.text: The production function that assumes some, but not perfect, substitutability among inputs is the ______ production function.

answers.text: Linear
Leontief
Cobb-Douglas
None of the above.

feedback: Correct! The Cobb-Douglas production function assumes some, but not perfect, substitutability among inputs. The linear production function assumes perfect substitution, and the Leontief assumes none.
